resources.string: Allows an app signed with the same certificate to ask for a Key Manager seed to open its save file. The seed is returned in memory only and is not logged.

Allows an app signed with the same certificate to start an XLM payment or payment request. The person holding the phone still sees the full amount and recipient, then confirms with biometrics, before anything is signed.
Stellar TimeLock phone-to-phone payment request. This is an app-to-app data exchange, not a card payment.
